name: Wizard Mutable Mage
body:
Doppelkin are simultaneously naturally transmuting their bodies and tricking others. Mutable mages use their natural abilities to blend transmutation and illusion studies.

Requirement: A mutable mage must be a doppelkin. A new ancestry from this book.

Mutable Illusionist (Ex)

At 1st level, a mutable mage gains both illusion and transmutation as school specializations. However, they must choose four prohibited schools, which cannot be divination or universal. The mutable mage still gains only one additional spell per level which can be used to prepare a transmutation or illusion spell. This ability replaces arcane school.

Morphic Familiar (Su)

At 1st level, a mutable mage must choose familiar for their arcane bond. At 5th level, the familiar can change its form, as a full-round action, to any other familiar available to the mutable mage at will, on command. This includes changing what bonuses the mutable mage gains from the familiar and which creatures the familiar can communicate with. This ability replaces the 5th-level bonus feat.

Reject Transformation (Ex)

At 10th level, a mutable mage can reject the changes from a transmutation spell or polymorph effect. If they fail their save against such an effect that has a duration greater than instantaneous, they can attempt an additional save 1 round later, at the same DC, to end the effect. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 10th level.
